title: Override Ceiling: Early-Refill History and Tailwise Pharmacy Pharmacy-Placed Renewals
content:
*Pharmacist practice note.*

The days' supply per fill of a renewal Tailwise Pharmacy places by itself is no more than the override ceiling. The override ceiling counts the renewed prescription's fills dispensed under an early-refill override — travel or lost or damaged, as recorded on each fill — within the 12 calendar months ending on the renewal date.

| Override fills within the 12 calendar months ending on the renewal date | Dispensed fills of the renewed prescription | Override ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| none | 4 or more | the class's maximum days' supply per fill |
| exactly one | 4 or more | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill plus 15 days, never more than the class maximum |
| two or more | any | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill |
| any | fewer than 4 | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; prescription written for 45 days, class maximum 90 days, renewal dated 2026-09-15)

- 5 dispensed fills, no override fill: ceiling 90 days.
- 5 dispensed fills, one travel override on 2026-02-01: ceiling 45 plus 15, 60 days.
- 5 dispensed fills, one lost or damaged override on 2025-06-01 only, outside the 12 months: ceiling 90 days.
- 3 dispensed fills, no override: ceiling 45 days.
